Why does a sports bar need a planetarium company?――Cosmをfull-stackで読む

Cosm looks like a giant-screen sports venue, but that description misses the hard part. Its lineage runs from planetarium technology and 1960s computer graphics to 10.5K capture, virtual cameras, media-rights partnerships, 12K×10K LED domes, and hospitality operations. This English Mix version separates ticket price, venue capex, and corporate funding; compares Japanese analogues such as THE LIVE, KDDI, and NTT West; and argues that Cosm’s visible invention is the dome, while its harder-to-copy asset is the vertically integrated chain connecting rights, capture, production, distribution, venue, and hospitality.
